# Nuked-OPN2 provenance

Retrieved from the official repository on 2026-10-10, pinned to
`335747d78cb0abbc3b55b004e62dad9763140115` (HEAD/master at retrieval).
`nuked-opn2/ym3438.c`, `ym3438.h`, `LICENSE` and `README.md` are copied from that
revision, with upstream notices intact. There are no synthesis modifications.

The header is authoritative for FFI: `OPN2_Clock` writes two `Bit16s` values.
The upstream README's `Bit32s` declaration is stale. Embedded C/header version
comments differ; use the commit above, not those comments, to identify the code.

Source: https://github.com/nukeykt/Nuked-OPN2/tree/335747d78cb0abbc3b55b004e62dad9763140115
